section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study examining associations between multiple facets of positive body image (body appreciation, body image flexibility, body pride, and body acceptance by others) and well-being dimensions in a large online sample of British adults. The study investigates sex differences in body image, associations with age, and relationships with self-reported BMI, with the hypothesis that positive body image facets will be significantly and positively associated with emotional, psychological, and social well-being.
